We're currently hiring for a Backend Software Engineer who will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining backend services and APIs that power our core products. The engineer will collaborate closely with product, frontend, DevOps, and QA teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and secure systems.

Requirements

Required:

• Strong experience with TypeScript, Node.js, and Express.

• Solid understanding of REST API design principles and best practices.

• Proficiency with MySQL and ORM frameworks (preferably Sequelize).

• Experience with asynchronous programming, error handling, and performance optimization in Node.js.

• Familiarity with containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes, or Nomad).

• Experience with Git-based workflows (GitHub, GitLab, or similar).

Nice to Have:

• Familiarity with PHP/Laravel (for interaction with our legacy platform).

• Understanding of security best practices for backend services.

• Experience with automated testing frameworks (Jest, Mocha, Cypress).

• Exposure to distributed or microservices-based architectures.

Comprehensive health coverage for you and your family, because your well-being comes first.

Take the time you need when you need it-no limits, no questions.

• Collaborative Work Culture
Join a supportive, inclusive, and team-focused environment that celebrates diversity.

• Growth Opportunities
Access tools, mentorship, and resources to elevate your skills and career.

title: Security Operations Manager
description: About the role We're looking for someone to build our security operations capability from the ground up. This covers how we spot when something is wrong, how we respond when it is, and how we keep improving both. It's a hands-on leadership role for the early stages, so you'll be setting things up and running them, not managing a large team from day one. You'll design how we do detection and monitoring for security, decide the right mix of in-house work and outsourced support, and set up how alerts are handled and escalated. You'll also lead how we respond to incidents, working closely with our engineering and reliability colleagues, since a lot of this sits alongside how they already keep our services running. This is a deeply collaborative role. In particular you'll work hand in hand with our site reliability engineering (SRE) team, since much of security monitoring and response builds on the same tooling and ways of working they already use to keep our services running. We want to avoid heavy, siloed processes and instead build a lean, practical capability that fits how the rest of the business works, bringing in specialist help where it makes sense. title: Partner Manager, AI Native Ecosystems
description:
About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies - from scrappy startups to global brands - use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.
About the role
Hi, my name is Marc, VP of Global Partnerships at Customer.io . A new wave of AI SaaS builders - Lovable, Vercel, Cursor, Bolt, and others - is becoming the default starting point for how software gets built, and each one is standing up its own marketplace or integration directory to connect what people build inside them to real backend services.
I'm hiring a Partner Manager, AI Native Ecosystems to make Customer.io the obvious, pre-integrated messaging and engagement layer for everything built on these platforms. This role sits at the intersection of business development and technical integration work: part of the job is identifying and recruiting the right platforms and negotiating partnership terms; the other part is working hands-on with our Product team to scope and ship the actual integration required to get listed and featured.
AI builder platforms are becoming a new front door for software creation - and a new distribution channel for infrastructure providers. Getting Customer.io natively integrated and well-positioned across this ecosystem now, while the partner programs and technical standards are still forming, is a land-grab opportunity. This role owns that land-grab end to end.
What we value

•
Bias to Action: comfortable building the process, not just executing an existing one - these marketplaces and their rules are new and changing monthly.

•
Cross-Functional Fluency: equally credible in a deal negotiation and a technical scoping conversation with engineers.

•
Ownership: drives a relationship from first contact through signed agreement through shipped integration, without waiting to be handed the next step.

•
Resourcefulness: comfortable operating without a dominant brand - you're earning the meeting, not getting it by default.

What you’ll do

•
Immediate priority: optimize our existing Claude and ChatGPT integrations, including MCP discoverability and GEO (making sure Customer.io shows up when AI tools recommend a messaging/engagement platform).

• Identify and prioritize which AI builder platforms (Vercel, Cursor, Lovable, Bolt, Google, AWS, and others) are worth partnering with, working with Engineering, Design, and Product to assess technical feasibility and distribution potential, including CLI and MCP connector priorities.

• Own the full partner relationship lifecycle - outbound, negotiation, and ongoing management - from first contact through signed agreement through shipped integration.

• Negotiate commercial terms (revenue share, co-marketing, marketplace listing requirements) directly with partner and BD counterparts.

• Translate each marketplace's technical requirements into a spec and work hands-on with our engineering team to scope and ship the integration - you don't need to write the integration yourself, but you need to be fluent enough to unblock it.

• Get Customer.io listed, verified, and ideally featured in each platform's marketplace or directory, and manage the relationship as review guidelines and requirements evolve.

• Track installs, activations, and pipeline sourced from each marketplace; report on which partnerships are driving real usage versus which need renegotiation or deprioritization.

• Build the playbook as you go - there's no existing process for this at Customer.io yet, and part of the job is creating repeatable criteria (target criteria, technical requirements checklist, deal template) so new platforms can be evaluated and onboarded quickly.

What we're looking for

• 5-7 years in business development, partnerships, or platform/ecosystem roles, ideally with a developer tools, API-first, or marketplace-driven

title: Electrical Technician (Power Generation) - Memphis
description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.  Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Power Generation team is seeking an Electrical Technician to operate and maintain plant electrical systems at SpaceX’s power generation facility. You will work hands-on across medium-voltage generation, distribution, and balance-of-plant electrical equipment up to 13.5 kV and 34.8 kV. This is an operations and maintenance role - you will switch, troubleshoot, repair, and keep electrical systems online in a high-reliability, fast-paced plant environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Perform operations and maintenance on plant electrical systems, including generators, transformers, switchgear, motor control centers, motors, VFDs, UPS units, automatic transfer switches, and emergency/black-start equipment, at voltages up to 13.5 kV and 34.8 kV.

• Execute switching, isolation, LOTO, racking of breakers, and restoration of medium-voltage equipment in accordance with plant procedures and NFPA 70E.

• Troubleshoot electrical faults on power distribution, protection, grounding, lighting, and auxiliary systems using one-line diagrams, schematics, and electrical test equipment.

• Perform preventive and predictive maintenance, inspections, and repairs to improve reliability and reduce unplanned downtime.

• Support plant startups, shutdowns, outages, and commissioning activities alongside operators, controls technicians, and engineers.

• Install, terminate, and maintain plant electrical equipment, cable, and control wiring as required for operations and maintenance work.

• Respond to electrical alarms, trips, and equipment failures; support root-cause investigations and implement corrective actions.

• Coordinate with operations, engineering, and utility personnel on switching, clearances, and electrical work that affects plant generation.

• Maintain accurate work orders, switching records, and as-found/as-left documentation.

• Follow all safety, LOTO, arc-flash, and PPE requirements while working in energized and hazardous plant environments.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate

• 3+ years of experience as an electrical technician, industrial electrician, or similar role maintaining industrial or power generation electrical systems.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience operating and maintaining medium-voltage electrical systems (4.16 kV to 34.8 kV), including switchgear, transformers, and breakers.

• Experience in a power plant, generating station, or other high-reliability industrial facility.

• Ability to read and interpret single-line diagrams, electrical schematics, and equipment O&M manuals.

• Experience with LOTO, switching procedures, and NFPA 70E / arc-flash safety practices.

• Experience troubleshooting motors, VFDs, MCCs, UPS systems, and plant auxiliary electrical equipment.

• Familiarity with electrical test equipment (multimeters, insulation testers, infrared, and similar).

• Journeyman electrician license or equivalent formal electrical training.

• Experience using a CMMS or work-order system to plan and close maintenance work.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a multi-discipline operations and maintenance team.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

title: Edge Compute Engineer
description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today’s five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Edge Compute Engineer to join the Latvia Design Center as the primary owner of our ground-segment compute and storage stack running the edge workloads running across all AST ground gateway stations. The Edge Compute Engineer owns the design, provisioning, and lifecycle of this platform across the full gateway fleet globally.

This is a design-and-operate role for a senior engineer who can define the edge compute reference architecture, build an IaC-driven fleet management stack, and take hands-on operational ownership. As the fleet scales, this role will also shape the edge compute platform for future edge functions beyond the current scope.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and own the edge compute reference architecture: virtualization platform (VMware-based virtualization or Kubernetes), VM/container topology, storage layout, virtual networking, and resource governance across the gateway fleet

• Design the platform to support confirmed edge workloads with headroom and architectural provision for deployment of future edge workloads

• Maintain architecture documentation, platform design records, and operational runbooks

• Build and maintain Terraform-based provisioning pipelines and PXE/TFTP-based boot and instance management for consistent, repeatable gateway node deployment

• Implement Ansible-based configuration management and GitOps workflows to enforce auditable configuration state across all hypervisor nodes remotely

• Manage virtualization cluster operations (VMware-based virtualization or Kubernetes): VM/pod lifecycle, HA, storage pools, virtual networking, and patching automation

• Maintain platform-level observability integrated into the central Prometheus/Grafana/VictoriaMetrics stack and support capacity planning as the fleet expands

• Enforce OS hardening baselines, PKI/certificate lifecycle (IAM Roles Anywhere, mTLS), encrypted storage, and firewall rules aligned with AST’s security governance

• Coordinate with on-site teams or vendors for server firmware, BIOS, and RAID configuration as needed; maintain accurate hardware and software inventory across the fleet

Qualifications

Education:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering, or a related field - or equivalent professional experience.

Experience:

A minimum of 5 to 8 years of hands-on experience in infrastructure or platform engineering, with a strong focus on hypervisor administration, Linux systems, and infrastructure-as-code. Demonstrated experience designing and operating distributed or edge compute environments.

• Deep hands-on VMware-based virtualization or Kubernetes (K8s) - cluster management, HA/DRS, virtual networking, storage pools

• Advanced administration (RHEL, Ubuntu, Debian) - systemd, network stack tuning, performance profiling, security hardening

• Terraform for infrastructure provisioning; PXE/TFTP-based boot and instance management; fleet-scale state management

• Ansible and GitOps workflows for drift-free, pipeline-driven configuration enforcement

• Cisco/Juniper networking (switching/routing), VLANs, VPN (IPsec/WireGuard), PrivateLink/private connectivity, last-mile network management, firewall management

• AWS hybrid cloud - Direct Connect, Site-to-Site VPN, PrivateLink integration with on-premises infrastructure

• Certificate lifecycle management, mTLS, IAM Roles Anywhere, access control for production edge infrastructure

• Prometheus, Grafana, VictoriaMetrics - hypervisor and VM health

• Own and evolve build performance: cache hit rates, execution parallelism, dependency hygiene, hermeticity, and reproducibility.

• Build and maintain developer-facing tooling that improves local iteration speed and CI reliability.

• Integrate and operate build infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments, balancing performance, security, and cost.

• Work directly with firmware, platform, and application teams to debug real-world build issues and eliminate systemic bottlenecks.

• Improve observability of build systems through metrics, logging, and analytics.

• Mentor engineers through code reviews, architectural discussions, and hands-on problem solving.

• Act as a technical advocate for modern build practices and scalable development workflows.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:

• Deep technical ownership with a bias toward implementation and measurable outcomes.

• Ability to balance architectural rigor with pragmatic delivery.

• Builds trust through technical credibility and consistent execution.

• Drives alignment by connecting build system improvements to developer productivity and product velocity.

• Acts as a hands-on technical leader shaping the long-term evolution of Intuitive ’s development platforms.

•
10+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong record of hands-on technical ownership .

• Deep, practical expertise with Bazel in complex C/C++ and embedded environments .

• Proven experience implementing and operating Bazel Remote Caching and Remote Execution at scale.

• Strong programming experience in Rust, C/C++, and Python .

• Experience debugging and optimizing distributed build systems, CI pipelines, and build infrastructure under real production constraints.

• Solid understanding of compiler toolchains, linkers, and build graph behavior.

Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:

12-15 years of relevant industry experience.

Its scope is broad, including Matching, Applications, Foundations, task processing, quotas and throttling, visibility, developer-facing primitives such as standalone activities, schedules, and streaming, and workflow experience improvements such as Continue-As-New, pause, and reset. We do not expect one person to cover all of these areas. We’re looking for an engineer who is excited to learn the system, contribute to new and/or ambiguous projects across the codebase, and help improve the reliability, performance, operability, and developer experience of Temporal over time. This is a hands-on engineering role where you’ll collaborate with experienced engineers to design, build, and operate components of Temporal’s distributed systems platform while growing your skills in distributed systems engineering.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Design, implement, test, and ship well-scoped features and improvements for the Temporal server with support from teammates.

• Work on distributed systems problems in areas such as task matching, scheduling, workflow execution, visibility, quotas, throttling, persistence, developer primitives, and workflow lifecycle features.

• Make thoughtful engineering tradeoffs with guidance, balancing developer experience, performance, and operability requirements.

• Partner with engineers, product managers, cloud teams, and customer-facing teams to understand requirements and deliver scalable solutions.

• Improve the reliability and operability of the server by adding tests, instrumentation, dashboards, alerts, runbooks, and documentation.

• Participate in design discussions and code reviews to learn best practices and contribute to a high-quality codebase.

• Contribute to improving the developer experience for open source users and enterprise customers through incremental improvements and bug fixes.

• Share knowledge with teammates and contribute to a collaborative engineering culture.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

• Experience building and operating production backend systems (distributed systems experience and concurrency experience).

• Strong computer science fundamentals, including concurrency basics, data structures, and debugging.

• Experience writing production-quality code in Go, Java, or another applicable backend language, with an emphasis on correctness and maintainability.

• Familiarity with core distributed systems concepts (e.g., fault tolerance, consistency tradeoffs, replication, scheduling, performance), with interest in deepening these skills.

• Ability to break down ambiguous problems into smaller tasks, ask good questions, and incorporate feedback from code review.

• Comfort working collaboratively across teams and communicating progress, risks, and tradeoffs clearly.

• Experience with testing practices and an operational mindset (logging, metrics, tracing, on-call empathy) is a plus.

• Experience with open source software or communities is a plus.

• Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP is a plus.

• Exposure to technologies such as Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, ClickHouse, Cassandra, PostgreSQL, or MySQL is a plus.

• Exposure to Kubernetes or related tooling (CRDs, KEDA, Argo) is a plus.

WHAT MAKES YOU A GOOD FIT

• You’re excited to continue building and deepening your distributed systems expertise.

• You enjoy learning large, complex codebases, think critically, thrive in ambiguity, and enjoy solving challenging problems.

• You take ownership of your work, follow through, and collaborate well with teammates.

• You balance technical depth with practical engineering decisions and are comfortable iterating toward better solutions.

• You don’t need prior Temporal experience-you’re excited to work on the core of a distributed system used by a large open source community and enterprise customers.

title: Semi-Senior QA Engineer (Manual & Automation)
description:
Semi-Senior QA Engineer (Manual & Automation)
Full-time contractor · Fully remote · Latin America only

Cloudnonic is an international, fully remote cloud and software company. We build customized cloud-native systems for clients in Europe and North America, and we're looking for a Semi-Senior QA engineer to join the team.

Who we are

Cloudnonic Corp . is a digitally native software and cloud startup based in the Kitchener/Waterloo area, Ontario, Canada. We're fully remote, with developers in Canada and South America and clients across Europe, North America, and South America. We work across healthcare, finance, construction, and manufacturing, and we take the time to understand each client's industry so we can serve it well with technology.

We're big on AI and the cloud. Our services range from app and web development to AI and cloud integration, plus technology consulting: designing feasible, secure, cost-effective architectures for non-technical clients and advising them on their tech stack.

The role

You'll test across multiple client projects, each with its own platform, users, and quirks. You'll need to understand a new platform quickly and see it the way its end users do: what they expect, where they get confused, and what breaks when they do something nobody planned for.

We ship weekly, from development to staging to production. You'll be the quality gate in between. That includes regression testing: running the same core flows release after release, carefully, every time. If repetition bores you, this isn't the right fit. If you see it as the job that protects users, it is.

We deliver AI-first. AI generates our tickets and acceptance criteria, we pair with AI while developing, and every pull request goes through AI review before a senior engineer reviews it. That makes us fast, and it makes QA more important, not less. We expect you to use AI to generate test cases, draft scripts, and speed up automation, and to know where it falls short: an AI-written test can pass while missing the bug a real user would hit. You need to judge whether a test actually proves something. If you can only run the tests an AI wrote for you, this isn't the role for you.

You'll work closely with developers and project managers, and you'll keep moving our testing forward by adopting new automation tools as they appear. Expect to be challenged constantly, and to enjoy the work along the way.

What you'll do

• Test new features and bug fixes across multiple client projects before they reach production

• Run regression testing on core user flows for every release

• Write clear test cases and test scripts based on acceptance criteria

• Build and maintain automated tests using modern tools, including AI-powered testing tools

• Report bugs with precise reproduction steps, expected vs. actual behavior, and evidence

• Evaluate features from the end user's perspective and flag usability issues, not only functional ones

• Work independently while keeping the team informed

We're looking for a self-starter who organizes their own day. We trust you to prioritize your week and keep everyone updated as you go.

Requirements

Language

• Fluent Spanish

• Advanced English (able to discuss issues with the team and clients)

Technical

• 2+ years of full-time QA experience

• Strong attention to detail

• Ability to learn new platforms quickly

• Experience writing test cases and test scripts

• Basic technical background: browser developer tools, API testing (e.g., Postman), and basic scripting in JavaScript or TypeScript

• Experience with test automation tools such as Playwright or Cypress

• Experience using AI tools in daily work, including for QA (test generation, test case design, automation)

• Experience with issue trackers (we use Linear)

• Experience with Agile methodologies

Bonus

• Experience testing healthcare or other regulated software

• Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines

• Fluent English (B2+)

• Stro

THINGS WE CARE ABOUT

- Transparency: Everyone can read about our roadmap, how we pay (or even let go of) people, our strategy, and how we work, in our public company handbook https://posthog.com/handbook. This will be the most productive job you've ever had.

- Ambition: We want to solve big problems. We strongly believe that aiming for the best possible upside, and sometimes missing, is better than never trying. We're optimistic about what's possible and our ability to get there.

Speechify 's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.
Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting - Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.
Overview
Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.
This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own - that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.
We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.
What You'll Do

• Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team - from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight

• Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features

• Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval

• Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself

• Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through

• Keep the shared pieces in working order - tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear

• Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own

• Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out

• When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time

• Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out

• Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear

• Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless

• Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early

• Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team

• Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

• 5+ years of software engineering experien

title: Custodian, 1st Shift, Site 4

Physical Requirements & Work Environment:

title: Strategic Account Lead
description:
Powering Great Work

We started as the place to find a trusted trade. Now, as we shape the future of home improvement, we're building the tech to transform that landscape for everyone - better products, smarter data, AI where it actually helps - so trades can spend less time on admin and consumers can find someone they trust, first time. That's Powering Great Work, and it's why every team here exists:

🔧 Trades spend less time on admin and more on winning work and growing their business

🏠 Homeowners get a trusted trade, first time, every time

🚀 We get to build products that change homes and lives across the country

As our next Strategic Account Lead, you'll work strategically with the business’ largest tradespartners to grow their business and maximise ROI on Checkatrade, while driving revenue through smarter product adoption. We’re looking for a true end to end relationship and revenue owner - you run and grow your book of business like its own p&l.

The job, unfiltered:

- Own a portfolio of high-value trade businesses end to end, and run a proactive outbound motion that grows revenue by getting them using and optimising the full Checkatrade suite.

- Build and run a clear monthly plan for every account, shaped by their goals, their data and the realities of their business.

- Influence decisions at every level, from owner to board, using performance data and a deep understanding of how trade businesses actually make money.

- Spot blockers before they cost revenue, then fix them. Design the processes and ways of working that make accounts run smoothly, so tradespeople can focus on growing.

- Build credible, high-trust relationships with senior stakeholders through regular contact and practical, strategic support. You’re their go-to commercial partner, not just their account manager.

The fit:

- A track record of managing and growing a significant book of revenue, with the results to prove it.

- A hybrid hunter/farmer mindset: hungry to achieve short-term revenue targets, while able to flex into building long-term strategic valued

- Real ownership of your portfolio, your performance and your commercial outcomes. You don’t wait to be told what to do next.

- Commercial credibility with senior decision-makers. You can challenge, advise and negotiate, and they listen.

- Resilience. When things don’t go to plan, you reset, adapt and keep moving.

- A collaborative, influential, people-first approach that makes people want to work with you, internally and externally.

- Confidence with CRM and AI tools, or the curiosity to pick them up fast and use them to work smarter.

- Adaptability and a willingness to learn quickly.

(Don't self-select out because you don't tick every box. We'd rather meet you.)

What you get

💰 Competitive salary, annual bonus & equity scheme

🩺 Health, wellbeing and learning support

🚲 Gym membership, Smart Tech Scheme, Cycle Scheme

🎂 Birthday/special day leave, buy & sell holiday scheme

❤️ 1 week's paid charity leave, and more

How this goes

- Screening call with one of our Talent Acquisition Partners

- 1st stage interview with the Head of Account Management

- 2nd stage interviews with senior stakeholders

- Final stage, including a case study presentation

Not this one? Stay close anyway. Join the Talent Community https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/checkatrade/form/register-interest and we'll ping you the second something better fits.

About us

We’re Checkatrade - the UK’s leading platform for finding a tradesperson. With more than 50,000 trades listed and over 6 million reviews, we help homeowners get jobs done right and help tradespeople grow their business.

We’re growing fast, with big plans to become the go-to brand for home improvements. If you care about great work, take pride in the details, and want to make an impact, you’ll fit right in.

At SoSafe our ambition is to be the leading cyber security awareness provider in Europe. Our award winning platform triggers behavioral change by providing effective and engaging training on cyber security and data protection. Backed by strong VC funding such as Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, focused expansion into the UKI market is the next step in our international growth. Our UK team is looking for a highly driven, results-focused Sales Development Rep to sell SoSafe’s disruptive solution to organisations across the United Kingdom and Ireland. Working closely with your Account Executive you will be a critical part of the growth mission.

Your Mission

- Be the tip of the spear - generate leads and build new opportunities for the sales funnel

- Qualify interest and book first meetings for your Account Executive, with a clear handover on what you’ve learned

- Build and manage the top-of-funnel pipeline

- Work in partnership with an Account Executive with director support from the Director UKI

- Be an ambassador for SoSafe within a growth territory - on social media and in person at industry events

Your Profile

- 1-year experience in a professional outbound calling role (SDR/BDR, recruitment, real estate, utilities)

- Understanding of SaaS and the ability to communicate the value of ours or your current proposition to the customer

- Demonstrable track record converting conversations into business opportunities

- Exceptional communication skills and interpersonal skills

- “Tech Savvy” and comfortable using the latest tools in research and outreach, including AI tools.

- Growth mindset and make-happen attitude for life in a fast-paced scale-up

- Fluent in English

Why Us?

Cybercrime is predicted to cost the world $10.5 Trillion annually by 2025 - we are inviting you to be part of the solution. You will have the opportunity to make a real impact, surrounded by a dynamic and supportive team and environment committed to your professional growth.

You will be provided with industry leading tools you need for success e.g. Salesforce CRM, Sales Nav, Groove, Aircall, Apple Macbook and an encouraging sales environment where you can bring out the best version of yourself and achieve your career and development goals.

What we offer:

Work-Life Balance:

- Flexible hours

- 33 vacation days

Work Environment:

- State-of-the-art tech

- Annual company off-site

- Regular team events

Healthcare:

- OpenUp

Other Perks:

- Referral Bonus

- Learning & Development Allowance

 

About Us

We are one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide. By putting people first and focusing on behavioral science, we are disrupting the status-quo of Cyber Security.

Backed by strong VC funding by those such as Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we are looking for more motivated team players who will assist us with our ambitious mission and international expansion. At SoSafe, you will take ownership for your work and your growth, taking your career to the next level! If you want to have an impact and are looking to contribute in meaningful ways within an open-minded environment that values diversity and community, SoSafe might just be the right place to work for you!

Are you our next Cyber Security Hero?

We are looking for a Junior Financial Planning & Reporting Specialist to join our FP&A team. Depending on your experience, you'll either grow into the role or take ownership from day one, supporting our management reporting activities and, over time, taking on broader controlling responsibilities.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Your Impact

As a Professional Services Manager II for Axon Air , you will lead the deployment of Axon drone technology for law enforcement, enterprise, and public safety agencies. This elevated role requires advanced technical proficiency, deep program management expertise, and the ability to independently manage complex deployments.

You will serve as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert (SME) , ensuring customers not only adopt Axon Air solutions but also realize their full potential to transform workflows and enhance organizational effectiveness. By combining advanced technical skills, regulatory knowledge, and consultative leadership, you will accelerate customer adoption, influence program expansion, and deliver long-term success.

Du brauchst keine vorherige Unterrichtserfahrung und kein Musikstudium. Wenn du dein Instrument gut beherrschst und Freude daran hast, anderen etwas beizubringen, kannst du als Instrumentallehrer starten.

Was solltest du mitbringen?

• Gute Kenntnisse in mindestens einem Musikinstrument

• Freude an Musik und daran, dein Wissen weiterzugeben

• Geduld und die Fähigkeit, Inhalte verständlich zu erklären

• Motivation, Anfänger und Fortgeschrittene zu unterstützen

• Zuverlässigkeit und gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

• Keine Unterrichtserfahrung erforderlich

• Kein abgeschlossenes Musikstudium notwendig

Was bieten wir dir?

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Du entscheidest, wann du unterrichten möchtest.

• Online oder vor Ort: Wähle die Unterrichtsform, die zu dir und deinen Schüler passt.

• 20-40 € pro Stunde: Lege deinen eigenen Stundensatz fest.

• Freie Zeiteinteilung: Ideal neben dem Studium, dem Beruf oder anderen Verpflichtungen.

• Flexibler Nebenverdienst: Verdiene Geld mit einer Fähigkeit, die dir Freude macht.

• Kreative Freiheit: Gestalte deinen Unterricht nach deinen musikalischen Interessen und den Zielen deiner Schüler.

Mach deine Leidenschaft für Musik zum Nebenjob!
Du spielst gerne ein Instrument und möchtest andere für Musik begeistern? Dann werde Teil von Nachhilfeunterricht , gib individuellen Instrumentalunterricht und begleite deine Schüler auf ihrem musikalischen Weg.
Teile dein musikalisches Können und verdiene 20-40 € pro Stunde - flexibel, kreativ und ohne vorherige Unterrichtserfahrung!

title: Technical Sales Support (Paging & Voice Evacuation)
description:
The Public Address Technical Sales Support team member is responsible for driving growth of the Bosch Public Address & Voice Alarm (PAVA) portfolio through a combination of market development, technical expertise, and go-to-market support. This role serves as the primary technical and strategic resource for Public Address, Paging and Mass Notification solutions, supporting project wins, enabling growth teams, influencing specifications and shaping regional and vertical GTM strategies.
The position bridges commercial strategy and hands-on technical support, acting as a trusted advisor to consultants, end users, integrators, and internal stakeholders. Success in this role is measured by project influence, revenue growth, specification adoption and the technical readiness of both internal and external partners.
Key Responsibilities
Growth & Market Development

• Support revenue growth for the PA portfolio by influencing specifications and helping win strategic projects.

• Qualify and develop PA opportunities across defined regions and vertical markets.

• Actively support major pursuits by providing technical support, solution positioning and competitive differentiation.

• Serve as a Public Address subject matter expert to Regional Sales Managers and Business Development teams.

Go-To-Market Strategy

• Define and execute Public Address go-to-market strategies aligned with regional and vertical priorities via the growth team.

• Support development of vertical-specific value propositions, reference architectures and sales enablement materials.

• Provide structured market feedback on competitive activity, customer needs and product gaps to marketing and product management.

Technical Pre-Sales & Project Support

• Provide L2 regional technical support for PA systems, including system architecture, design reviews and solution validation.

• Assist with project designs, drawings and technical documentation to support bids and proposals.

• Support system commissioning strategy, escalation handling and resolution of L2 technical issues as required.

• Act as a technical liaison between growth team and level three application support team.

Training

• Support internal and external Sales/Growth training initiatives.
Voice of Customer (VoC) & Lifecycle Support

• Capture and communicate Voice of Customer insights throughout the product lifecycle.

• Participate in product feedback loops related to roadmap planning, certifications and compliance requirements.

• Support local and regional certification efforts related to Public Address standards and regulations.

Industry & Partner Engagement

• Represent Public Address at industry events, trade shows, roadshows and customer briefings.

• Bachelor’s degree required

• 2-5 years of experience in technical support, technical sales support, or related client-facing role

• Strong technical aptitude with the ability to clearly communicate technical solutions to diverse audiences

• Familiarity with public address (PA) systems and audio technologies

• Hands-on experience with AoIP systems

• Solid understanding of networking concepts and infrastructure

• Prior experience or exposure within the relevant industry

• Experience in the preparation and review of tender specifications

• Hands-on experience in a systems integration environment

• Proven ability to build and maintain strong professional relationships

• Excellent presentation and communication skills

• Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% as needed

• Must reside within reasonable proximity to a major airport

description:
Job Title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
Reports To: Chief People Officer
Department: Human Resources
Schedule: Monday-Friday, standard business hours
Work Location: US-Remote (preference for candidates based in or near Irvine, CA)
About Genea

As leaders in property technology, Genea provides cloud-based physical security, submeter billing and on-demand HVAC solutions to over 1 million users across 39 countries. But Genea is more than just a workplace. We're a mission-driven team that collaborates, innovates, and engineers the proptech solutions of tomorrow to solve the challenges of today. We pride ourselves on fostering an environment of teamwork, transparency and authenticity, where you can be yourself. But don't take our word for it. Genea has been recognized as a Top Workplace in 2021-2025, with a rating of 4.3 out of 5 stars on Glassdoor. Our team members love our competitive benefits, including 401k matching, PTO, 100% paid parental leave, remote work options, and development/training opportunities.
Job Overview
The Talent Acquisition Specialist owns US hiring at Genea , leading full-cycle recruiting for approximately 50 positions a year. Searches span every part of the business: corporate functions, Operations, Business Development, Marketing, Technology, and Product. Reporting to the Chief People Officer, you will partner with HR Business Partners, hiring managers, and leadership to run each search from intake through offer. This role suits a recruiter who has hired for both technical and corporate roles and wants the breadth of owning a company's full US hiring plan as an individual contributor.
Duties and Responsibilities

• Own full-cycle recruiting for approximately 50 US hires per year across corporate, Operations, Business Development, Marketing, Technology, and Product roles.

• Lead intake meetings with hiring managers to define requirements, selection criteria, interview plans, and hiring timelines for each role.

• Source and engage passive candidates through LinkedIn and other channels, building pipelines for open and recurring roles.

• Develop creative recruiting and sourcing approaches for specialized and hard-to-fill technical and corporate roles.

• Screen and assess candidates against role requirements, and present qualified shortlists with clear recommendations to hiring managers.

• Manage interview processes and candidate communication so every candidate has a clear, timely, and consistent experience.

• Prepare, extend, and negotiate offers, partnering with the Chief People Officer and hiring managers to close selected candidates.

• Write and post job descriptions and job postings that accurately reflect each role and meet Genea standards.

• Partner with HR Business Partners, hiring managers, and leadership to align hiring priorities and timelines with business needs.

• Maintain accurate requisition and candidate records in Greenhouse, and report recruiting metrics and hiring progress to the Chief People Officer and leadership.

Performs other related duties as assigned by management.
Qualifications

• 5+ years of full-cycle corporate (in-house) recruiting experience.

• Experience recruiting for both technical roles, such as engineering and product, and non-technical corporate roles.

• Recruiting experience in a fast-paced, growing SaaS or technology company.

• Demonstrated success sourcing and engaging passive candidates through LinkedIn and other channels.

• Experience extending and negotiating offers.

• Working proficiency with an applicant tracking system.

• Experience with Greenhouse, preferred.

• Strong collaborator who builds productive working relationships with HR Business Partners, hiring managers, and leadership.

• Clear, effective written and verbal communication, including writing job postings that attract qualified candidates.

• Able to travel to the Irvine, CA office two to four times per year.

Compensation: $90,000 - $120,000 annual base salary

title: Technical Integration Specialist (EMEA)
description:
ABOUT THE POSITION

Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first ecommerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains.

 

As a Technical Integration Specialist, you will improve the e-commerce experience for hundreds of millions of users across the world by providing first level technical support to e-commerce companies (our customers) as they integrate their websites and mobile applications with Constructor's platform. This includes:

- Onboarding support - Collaborating with customers to understand their technical integration needs and assist them through the integration process

- API and library education - Providing expert guidance on integrating with Constructor's APIs and utilizing open source libraries

- Troubleshooting - Helping resolve technical challenges and integration issues alongside Customer Success teams

- Index configuration - Working with customers to ensure their product catalogs are properly configured, including uploading catalog data, configuring facets, searchabilities, sort orders, and retrieving results

- Communication - Acting as a liaison between customers and other technical resources, responding promptly to inquiries with clear explanations

- Process improvement - Documenting customer interactions, common issues, and solutions, improving integration documentation and customer onboarding

REQUIREMENTS

- Proven experience in customer support or technical support roles

- Knowledge of REST-based web services, APIs, and integration best practices

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences

- Detail-oriented with a commitment to delivering exceptional customer support

- Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to issue resolution

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Familiarity with structured data formats (JSON, CSV) and basic search/index concepts

- Familiarity with debugging tools such as browser dev tools, API clients (e.g., Postman), or logs.

- Familiarity with A/B testing, understanding of server side and client side contexts, network request routing / HTTP.

- Familiarity working with open source libraries, JavaScript web application development and integration patterns.

BENEFITS

- 🧠 Work with smart and empathetic people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact

- 🌎 Fully remote team - choose where you live

- 🎉 Regular team offsites to connect and collaborate

- 🏝️ Unlimited vacation time - we strongly encourage all of our employees take at least 3 weeks per year

- 🛋️ Work from home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office

- 💵 Base salary: $70k-$90k USD, depending on knowledge, skills, experience, and interview results

- 💻 Apple laptops provided for new employees

- 🧑‍🎓 Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year

- 👪 Maternity & Paternity leave for qualified employees

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION AT CONSTRUCTOR

At Constructor.io http://Constructor.io we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or affiliation in any other protected group.

 

How we handle your data. By submitting this application, you acknowledge that Constructor will collect and process the personal data you provide for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for this role. If you are not selected, we will retain your data for a limited period as described in our Recruitment Privacy Notice https://constructor.com/recruitment-privacy-notice.

title: Account-Based Marketing Manager
description:
TITLE: Account-Based Marketing Manager
LOCATION: Remote
REPORTS TO: SVP, Growth Marketing
DEPARTMENT: Growth Center of Excellence
WORK TYPE: Full-time, Remote (Travel required up to four times per year for team meetings and corporate events.)
CCS is unable to sponsor employment visas for this position, such as H-1B visas. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future visa sponsorship. This may apply to individuals currently authorized under temporary student or practical training visas, who will require sponsorship from CCS to maintain work authorization long-term.

WHO WE ARE
CCS Fundraising is a strategic fundraising firm that helps nonprofits achieve transformational change. Since 1947, we have partnered with leading organizations across sectors to plan and deliver fundraising programs that advance their missions. Today, more than 600 CCS professionals across 18 offices support over 700 nonprofit organizations each year.
CCS is entering an exciting chapter of growth, with new investment in business intelligence, technology, and an enterprise-wide Growth Office. The Solutions business at CCS has historically been small, representing about 5% of total revenue. The CCS leadership team views Solutions as an important opportunity for hyper acceleration and has made it a high priority, with increased investment and an objective of turning it into a growth engine for CCS moving forward. This role offers the opportunity to help shape how a highly respected, mission-driven firm brings modern Solutions to its clients, and to help design the go-to-market engine to propel Solutions’ growth.
UNDERSTANDING THE ROLE
In close coordination with the Solutions leader, accelerate growth of the Solutions business at CCS, a highly strategic offering expected to be a key growth driver for the firm. By activating external and internal communications, targeting CCS clients and prospective clients, and building awareness and demand, drive new opportunities across CCS’s four regions.
Turn enterprise and regional growth priorities into targeted marketing programs that create engagement, opportunities, and pipeline.
This is a high-impact growth enablement role at the center of CCS's enterprise marketing and business development efforts. You will partner with the Solutions organization nationally, and with regional leaders, business development, sellers, and the central Marketing team to translate agreed market, sector, account, and pipeline priorities into focused campaigns, seller-ready tools, and high-quality opportunities. As the Account-Based Marketing Manager, you will support CCS’s highest priority offering across the entire firm and serve as the primary Growth Office liaison for that business unit.
You will not be expected to do it alone. You will bring together marketing, business intelligence, events, regional operations, sector and market subject-matter experts, and external production resources to help sellers create more conversations and win more business.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
Your work will help CCS create incremental demand and position our regional salesforce to work more effectively. Success will be visible in:

• More marketing-attributed high-quality Solutions appointments and opportunities secured with priority contacts at target organizations.

• Stronger regional adoption of centralized campaigns, insights, and sales tools.

• Clearer alignment between the overall growth plans, with focus on Solutions, and central marketing investment.

• Repeatable campaigns that improve pipeline and contribute to regional revenue growth.

RESPONSIBILITIES

•
Solutions growth activation . Build trusted relationships within Solutions and with regional executives, sellers, and regional strategy, marketing, operations, and business development teams; understand agreed market, sector, account, and pipeline priorities and translate them into focused marketing activation. Partner with appropriate practitioners

title: Education & AI Policy Researcher
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Policy Researcher to support a regional initiative focused on the intersection of education, technology, and AI.

The role will focus on understanding government priorities, policy and regulatory environments, institutional structures, and emerging developments that may influence the adoption of AI and technology within education systems across the MENA region.

This is an applied research role. We are looking for someone who can go beyond collecting information and translate research into clear, practical insights and recommendations for program and stakeholder engagement.

Key Responsibilities

• Research national policies, strategies, regulations, and government initiatives related to education, AI, digital transformation, and teacher development.

• Analyze how governments and education authorities are approaching AI adoption and responsible use within education.

• Identify relevant policy developments, opportunities, constraints, and potential risks.

• Map key government entities, ministries, education authorities, regulators, universities, and other relevant institutions.

• Identify key stakeholders, decision-makers, influencers, and potential institutional champions.

• Map existing government-led and institutional initiatives related to AI, digital education, and educator development.

• Analyze potential barriers and enablers to institutional adoption.

• Identify opportunities to align initiatives with national education and AI priorities.

• Develop recommendations for government and institutional engagement.

• Prepare concise briefing notes ahead of stakeholder meetings.

• Track relevant policy and regulatory developments throughout the engagement.

• Support the team in understanding potential pathways for long-term institutional adoption and sustainability.

Expected Deliverables

The researcher may be responsible for:

• Country-level policy and landscape briefs.

• Government and institutional stakeholder maps.

• National strategy and policy mapping.

• Mapping of relevant existing initiatives.

• Opportunity, barrier, and risk analysis.

• Stakeholder prioritization and engagement recommendations.

• Briefing notes for government and institutional meetings.

• Regular updates on relevant policy or regulatory developments.

• Strategic recommendations based on research findings.

What We are Looking For

• Experience in public policy, education policy, government affairs, international development, or policy research.

• Strong research and analytical skills, particularly in interpreting government strategies, policies, and regulatory frameworks.

• Good understanding of government and institutional ecosystems in the MENA region.

• Experience in education, technology, AI policy, digital transformation, or workforce development is highly desirable.

• Ability to translate complex research into clear recommendations for non-policy audiences.

• Strong stakeholder-mapping skills.

• Excellent written communication and ability to prepare concise executive-level briefs.

• Ability to work independently and manage research across multiple markets.

• Professional fluency in English; Arabic is strongly preferred.

Nice to Have

• Previous experience working with or researching Ministries of Education, government entities, education authorities, or universities.

• Experience supporting regional or multi-country initiatives.

• Familiarity with public-sector decision-making and government engagement in MENA.

What Success Looks Like

The researcher provides the team with a clear understanding of the policy environment, government priorities, relevant stakeholders, potential barriers, and opportunities in each market.
